prompt:
The section file sections/size-guide-panel.liquid renders a size table. It can optionally wrap the table in a panel element chosen by the merchant. Its markup is already correct. Do not change anything outside the {% schema %} block. Replace the schema JSON so that it is exactly the following, with keys and array items in the stated order.

Top-level keys, in this order:
1. "name": "Size guide".
2. "tag": "aside". This is the element Shopify wraps the whole section in. It is not the merchant-selectable panel element.
3. "class": "section-size-guide".
4. "settings": an array with 6 items, in this order:
   a. {"type":"header","content":"Layout"}
   b. checkbox, id "show_wrapper", label "Wrap table in panel", default true.
   c. select, id "wrapper_tag", label "Panel element". Its options, in this order, are value "div" with label "Div", value "section" with label "Section", and value "figure" with label "Figure". Default "div". Key order: type, id, label, options, default.
   d. {"type":"header","content":"Content"}
   e. text, id "heading", label "Heading", default "Size guide".
   f. richtext, id "note", label "Fit note", with no default key.
5. "blocks": one block type. Its type is "size_row" and its name is "Size row". Its settings, in order, are:
   - text, id "label", label "Size label", default "M".
   - text, id "chest", label "Chest", with no default.
   - text, id "waist", label "Waist", with no default.
6. "max_blocks": 12.
7. "presets": one preset named "Size guide". Its "blocks" array holds three size_row blocks, in this order, with settings {"label":"S"}, {"label":"M"} and {"label":"L"}.

Setting key order is type, id, label, then default where present. No other keys may appear anywhere. Change only sections/size-guide-panel.liquid. Do not suppress checks or hardcode case values. All input keys are present.
